components.name: Entry tour arrow
components.description: Circular 44px tour navigation control over the food background.
components.html: <button class="ds-entry-arrow" aria-label="Next slide"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m9 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-entry-arrow { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid #ffffff55; border-radius: 50%; background: #07141b66; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-entry-arrow:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #ffffff24; } .ds-entry-arrow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ff3f6c); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-entry-arrow:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

narrative.overview: The approved entry surfaces extend this identity with a dark-teal rotating-cuisine welcome and full-screen cuisine imagery on the tour/sign-in and onboarding screens. This is an entry-specific treatment; the authenticated app retains the existing Shoku Glass system.
dos: Do retain the rotating-cuisine welcome and full-screen cuisine imagery within the entry flow; do not extend this page composition into an app-wide redesign.
donts: Don't add quote carousels or extra waits to the splash.
